# Packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(lme4)
library(psych)
library(metafor)
library(here)
```

# Helper functions

```{r}
source(here::here("functions", "inter_lab_variability_helpers.R"))
```

# Load data

```{r}
# load AXYS donor metadata
axys_metadata <- read_csv(here("data", "2024-08-22_donor_characteristics_FINAL.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(BMI_category = case_when(BMI < 24.9 ~ "Lean",
                                  BMI >= 24.9 & BMI <= 29.9 ~ "Overweight",
                                  BMI > 29.9 ~ "Obese"),
         Hba1c_category = case_when(Hba1c < 6 ~ "Normoglycemic",
                                    Hba1c <= 6.5 ~ "Prediabetic",
                                    Hba1c > 6.5 ~ "Diabetic"),
         BMI_category = factor(BMI_category, levels = c("Lean", "Overweight", "Obese")),
         Hba1c_category = factor(Hba1c_category, levels = c("Normoglycemic", "Prediabetic", "Diabetic")),
         Sex = as_factor(Sex),
         Diabetes_status = as_factor(Diabetes_status)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Purity)

# Donor IDs
axys_donors <- axys_metadata %>%
  dplyr::pull(Id)
```

```{r}
# load GSIS data from ADI
gsis_adi_param <- read_excel(here("data", "Perifusion+GSIS", "2024-05-18_IsletCore_GSIS_from_TeamGrant_website.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(Cond = factor(Cond, levels = c("1", "2", "3")),
                replicate = as.character(replicate))

gsis_adi_ave <- gsis_adi_param %>%
  mutate(across(4:ncol(.), as.numeric)) %>%
  group_by(Donor, Cond) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(InsulinContent_IsletCore = mean(InsulinContent),
                LG_IsletCore = mean(LG, na.rm = TRUE),
                HG_IsletCore = mean(HG, na.rm = TRUE),
                SI_IsletCore = mean(SI, na.rm = TRUE),
                .keep = c("unused")) %>%
  distinct(Donor, Cond, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(-replicate) %>%
  ungroup()
  
gsis_adi_wide <- gsis_adi_ave %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cond, values_from = c(InsulinContent_IsletCore, LG_IsletCore, HG_IsletCore, SI_IsletCore)) %>%
  relocate(Donor, InsulinContent_IsletCore_1, LG_IsletCore_1, HG_IsletCore_1, SI_IsletCore_1,
           InsulinContent_IsletCore_2, LG_IsletCore_2, HG_IsletCore_2, SI_IsletCore_2,
           InsulinContent_IsletCore_3, LG_IsletCore_3, HG_IsletCore_3, SI_IsletCore_3) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Donor %in% axys_donors)
```

```{r}
# Load Myriam perifusion data
glu_peri_mh <- read_excel(here("data", "Perifusion+GSIS", "2024-01-25_Perifusion_FINAL DATA_For analysis_AC.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(PerifusionParam = str_c("MH", PerifusionParam, sep = "_"),
         .keep = c("unused")) %>% 
  mutate(across(3:ncol(.), as.numeric))

glu_peri_mh_t <- glu_peri_mh %>%
  dplyr::select(-MainOutcome) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  set_names(.[1, ]) %>%
  slice_tail(., n = (nrow(.)-1)) %>%
  mutate(Donor = rownames(.),
         .keep = c("unused")) %>%
  mutate(Donor = str_remove(Donor, pattern = "Donor"),
         across(where(is.character), str_squish)) %>%
  relocate(Donor) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Donor %in% c("R419", "R421"))
```

```{r}
# Keep columns to compare across labs
mh_peri <- glu_peri_mh_t %>%
  dplyr::select("Donor", "MH_LGauc", "MH_HGauc", "MH_HGauc_LGauc")

adi_gsis <- gsis_adi_wide %>%
  dplyr::select("Donor", "LG_IsletCore_1", "HG_IsletCore_1", "SI_IsletCore_1")
```

```{r}
# Combined MH and ADI columns
mh_adi <- mh_peri %>%
  left_join(adi_gsis, by = c("Donor" = "Donor")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Donor = Donor,
    LG_AUC_Lab1 = MH_LGauc,
    HG_AUC_Lab1 = MH_HGauc,
    SI_Lab1     = MH_HGauc_LGauc,
    LG_AUC_Lab2 = LG_IsletCore_1,
    HG_AUC_Lab2 = HG_IsletCore_1,
    SI_Lab2     = SI_IsletCore_1
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
    LG_AUC_Lab1 = as.numeric(LG_AUC_Lab1),
    HG_AUC_Lab1 = as.numeric(HG_AUC_Lab1),
    SI_Lab1 = as.numeric(SI_Lab1)
  )

# Pivot combined dataframe to long format
mh_adi_long <- mh_adi %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Donor,
    names_to = c("Measure", "Lab"),
    names_sep = "_Lab",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lab = paste0("Lab", Lab)
  )

# z-transform values in the wide-format dataframe
mh_adi_std <- mh_adi %>%
  mutate(
    z_LG_AUC_Lab1 = scale(LG_AUC_Lab1)[,1],
    z_LG_AUC_Lab2 = scale(LG_AUC_Lab2)[,1],
    
    z_HG_AUC_Lab1 = scale(HG_AUC_Lab1)[,1],
    z_HG_AUC_Lab2 = scale(HG_AUC_Lab2)[,1],

    z_SI_Lab1 = scale(SI_Lab1)[,1],
    z_SI_Lab2 = scale(SI_Lab2)[,1]
  )

# z-transform values in the long-format dataframe
mh_adi_long_std <- mh_adi_long %>%
  group_by(Lab, Measure) %>%
  mutate(value_std = (value - mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(value, na.rm = TRUE))
```

# Variance-component analysis

```{r}
# Run models
# Note: lmer() drops rows with NA in the outcome; donors with missing values are excluded per metric.

## Raw (non-standardized) models
mod_LG <- lmer(
  value ~ 1 + (1 | Lab) + (1 | Donor),
  data = mh_adi_long %>% filter(Measure == "LG_AUC")
)

mod_HG <- lmer(
  value ~ 1 + (1 | Lab) + (1 | Donor),
  data = mh_adi_long %>% filter(Measure == "HG_AUC")
)

mod_SI <- lmer(
  value ~ 1 + (1 | Lab) + (1 | Donor),
  data = mh_adi_long %>% filter(Measure == "SI")
)

## Standardized models - used z-transformed values
mod_LG_std <- lmer(
  value_std ~ 1 + (1 | Lab) + (1 | Donor),
  data = mh_adi_long_std %>% filter(Measure == "LG_AUC")
)

mod_HG_std <- lmer(
  value_std ~ 1 + (1 | Lab) + (1 | Donor),
  data = mh_adi_long_std %>% filter(Measure == "HG_AUC")
)

mod_SI_std <- lmer(
  value_std ~ 1 + (1 | Lab) + (1 | Donor),
  data = mh_adi_long_std %>% filter(Measure == "SI")
)
```

```{r}
# Variance components
vc_LG <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_LG))
vc_LG$prop <- vc_LG$vcov / sum(vc_LG$vcov)
vc_LG$prop_pct <- 100 * vc_LG$prop

vc_HG <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_HG))
vc_HG$prop <- vc_HG$vcov / sum(vc_HG$vcov)
vc_HG$prop_pct <- 100 * vc_HG$prop

vc_SI <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_SI))
vc_SI$prop <- vc_SI$vcov / sum(vc_SI$vcov)
vc_SI$prop_pct <- 100 * vc_SI$prop
```

```{r}
vc_LG_std <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_LG_std))
vc_LG_std$prop <- vc_LG_std$vcov / sum(vc_LG_std$vcov)
vc_LG_std$prop_pct <- 100 * vc_LG_std$prop

vc_HG_std <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_HG_std))
vc_HG_std$prop <- vc_HG_std$vcov / sum(vc_HG_std$vcov)
vc_HG_std$prop_pct <- 100 * vc_HG_std$prop

vc_SI_std <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_SI_std))
vc_SI_std$prop <- vc_SI_std$vcov / sum(vc_SI_std$vcov)
vc_SI_std$prop_pct <- 100 * vc_SI_std$prop
```

# Intraclass Correlation Coefficients (ICC)

```{r}
ICC_LG_raw  <- ICC(mh_adi[, c("LG_AUC_Lab1", "LG_AUC_Lab2")])
ICC_HG_raw  <- ICC(mh_adi[, c("HG_AUC_Lab1", "HG_AUC_Lab2")])
ICC_SI_raw  <- ICC(mh_adi[, c("SI_Lab1",    "SI_Lab2")])

ICC_LG_std <- ICC(mh_adi_std[, c("z_LG_AUC_Lab1", "z_LG_AUC_Lab2")])
ICC_HG_std <- ICC(mh_adi_std[, c("z_HG_AUC_Lab1", "z_HG_AUC_Lab2")])
ICC_SI_std <- ICC(mh_adi_std[, c("z_SI_Lab1",     "z_SI_Lab2")])
```

```{r}
list(
  LG_AUC_ICC_raw = ICC_LG_raw$results,
  HG_AUC_ICC_raw = ICC_HG_raw$results,
  SI_ICC_raw     = ICC_SI_raw$results,
  
  LG_AUC_ICC_std = ICC_LG_std$results,
  HG_AUC_ICC_std = ICC_HG_std$results,
  SI_ICC_std     = ICC_SI_std$results
)
```

# Random-effects Meta-analysis

```{r}
# Remove rows with missing AUCs for Lab 1 (Bruin)
lab1 <- mh_adi %>% 
  dplyr::select(Donor, LG_AUC_Lab1, HG_AUC_Lab1) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(LG_AUC_Lab1), !is.na(HG_AUC_Lab1))

# Extract LG and HG values and the sample size
lg1 <- lab1$LG_AUC_Lab1
hg1 <- lab1$HG_AUC_Lab1
n1  <- length(lg1)

# Calculate within-donor correlation LG vs HG for paired effect size
r1 <- cor(lg1, hg1, use = "complete.obs")

# Compute effect size: LG vs HG for Lab 1
es_lab1 <- escalc(
  measure = "SMCR",          
  m1i = mean(lg1),           
  m2i = mean(hg1),           
  sd1i = sd(lg1),            
  sd2i = sd(hg1),            
  ri  = r1,                  
  ni  = n1
)

es_lab1$yi  # effect size estimate (Hedges-type g)
es_lab1$vi  # sampling variance
```

```{r}
# Remove rows with missing AUCs for Lab 2 (IsletCore)
lab2 <- mh_adi %>% 
  dplyr::select(Donor, LG_AUC_Lab2, HG_AUC_Lab2) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(LG_AUC_Lab2), !is.na(HG_AUC_Lab2))

# Extract LG and HG values and the sample size
lg2 <- lab2$LG_AUC_Lab2
hg2 <- lab2$HG_AUC_Lab2
n2  <- length(lg2)

# Calculate within-donor correlation LG vs HG for paired effect size
r2 <- cor(lg2, hg2, use = "complete.obs")

# Compute effect size: LG vs HG for Lab 2
es_lab2 <- escalc(
  measure = "SMCR",
  m1i = mean(lg2),
  m2i = mean(hg2),
  sd1i = sd(lg2),
  sd2i = sd(hg2),
  ri  = r2,
  ni  = n2
)

es_lab2$yi
es_lab2$vi
```

```{r}
esdat <- data.frame(
  lab = c("Lab1", "Lab2"),
  yi  = c(es_lab1$yi, es_lab2$yi),
  vi  = c(es_lab1$vi, es_lab2$vi)
)

esdat
```

```{r}
# Meta-analysis via linear mixed-effects model
# yi = effect sizes, vi = sampling variances, REML = Residual Maximum Likelihood
res <- rma(yi = yi, vi = vi, data = esdat, method = "REML")
res
```

```{r}
# Extract and view results
pooled_g   <- res$b[1] 
se         <- res$se 
ci_lower   <- res$ci.lb 
ci_upper   <- res$ci.ub 
tau2       <- res$tau2
I2         <- res$I2

c(pooled_g = pooled_g, se = se, ci_lower = ci_lower, ci_upper = ci_upper,
  tau2 = tau2, I2 = I2)
```

```{r}
forest(
  res,
  slab = esdat$lab,
  xlab = "Standardized mean change (HG vs LG)",
  mlab = "Random-effects model"
)

funnel(
  res,
  xlab = "Effect size (yi)",
  ylab = "Standard error"
)
```

# Generate a summary table

```{r}
# ICC(2,1) for each metric (standardized)
ICC_LG  <- icc2_from_psych(ICC_LG_std)
ICC_HG  <- icc2_from_psych(ICC_HG_std)
ICC_SI  <- icc2_from_psych(ICC_SI_std)

# Meta-analysis stats for HG vs LG
meta_row <- list(
  pooled_g = as.numeric(res$b[1]),
  ci_low   = as.numeric(res$ci.lb),
  ci_high  = as.numeric(res$ci.ub),
  tau2     = as.numeric(res$tau2),
  I2       = as.numeric(res$I2)
)

# Assemble summary table
summary_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("LG AUC", "HG AUC", "Stimulation Index"),

  # ICC2 from standardized data
  ICC2 = c(ICC_LG$ICC2, ICC_HG$ICC2, ICC_SI$ICC2),
  ICC2_CI = c(
    sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ICC_LG$ICC2_low, ICC_LG$ICC2_high),
    sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ICC_HG$ICC2_low, ICC_HG$ICC2_high),
    sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ICC_SI$ICC2_low, ICC_SI$ICC2_high)
  ),
  ICC2_p = c(ICC_LG$ICC2_p, ICC_HG$ICC2_p, ICC_SI$ICC2_p),

  # Variance components (%)
  Donor_var_pct    = c(
    get_vc_row(vc_LG, "Donor"),
    get_vc_row(vc_HG, "Donor"),
    get_vc_row(vc_SI, "Donor")
  ),
  Lab_var_pct      = c(
    get_vc_row(vc_LG, "Lab"),
    get_vc_row(vc_HG, "Lab"),
    get_vc_row(vc_SI, "Lab")
  ),
  Residual_var_pct = c(
    get_vc_row(vc_LG, "Residual"),
    get_vc_row(vc_HG, "Residual"),
    get_vc_row(vc_SI, "Residual")
  ),

  # Meta-analysis (only meaningful for HG vs LG; NA for others)
  pooled_g = c(NA, meta_row$pooled_g, NA),
  meta_CI  = c(
    NA,
    sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", meta_row$ci_low, meta_row$ci_high),
    NA
  ),
  tau2     = c(NA, meta_row$tau2, NA),
  I2       = c(NA, meta_row$I2, NA)
)

summary_table
```

## Full ICC table (raw + standardized)

```{r}
# Convert each ICC extraction to a tibble before mutate()
icc_LG_raw_tbl  <- as_tibble(icc2_from_psych(ICC_LG_raw)) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "LG AUC", Type = "Raw")

icc_HG_raw_tbl  <- as_tibble(icc2_from_psych(ICC_HG_raw)) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "HG AUC", Type = "Raw")

icc_SI_raw_tbl  <- as_tibble(icc2_from_psych(ICC_SI_raw)) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "SI", Type = "Raw")

icc_LG_std_tbl  <- as_tibble(icc2_from_psych(ICC_LG_std)) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "LG AUC", Type = "Standardized")

icc_HG_std_tbl  <- as_tibble(icc2_from_psych(ICC_HG_std)) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "HG AUC", Type = "Standardized")

icc_SI_std_tbl  <- as_tibble(icc2_from_psych(ICC_SI_std)) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "SI", Type = "Standardized")

icc_full_table <- bind_rows(
  icc_LG_raw_tbl,
  icc_HG_raw_tbl,
  icc_SI_raw_tbl,
  icc_LG_std_tbl,
  icc_HG_std_tbl,
  icc_SI_std_tbl
) %>%
  relocate(Metric, Type) %>%
  mutate(
    ICC2_CI = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ICC2_low, ICC2_high)
  )

icc_full_table
```
## Variance-component table (Donor vs Lab vs Residual)

```{r}
# vc_props is a helper function to compute % variance per random-effect group

# Raw models
vc_LG_tbl <- vc_props(mod_LG, "LG AUC", "Raw")
vc_HG_tbl <- vc_props(mod_HG, "HG AUC", "Raw")
vc_SI_tbl <- vc_props(mod_SI, "SI",     "Raw")

# Standardized models
vc_LG_std_tbl <- vc_props(mod_LG_std, "LG AUC", "Standardized")
vc_HG_std_tbl <- vc_props(mod_HG_std, "HG AUC", "Standardized")
vc_SI_std_tbl <- vc_props(mod_SI_std, "SI",     "Standardized")

# Combine
vc_full_table <- bind_rows(
  vc_LG_tbl,
  vc_HG_tbl,
  vc_SI_tbl,
  vc_LG_std_tbl,
  vc_HG_std_tbl,
  vc_SI_std_tbl
) %>%
  # nicer labels
  mutate(
    grp = dplyr::recode(grp,
                        "Donor"    = "Donor",
                        "Lab"      = "Lab",
                        "Residual" = "Residual")
  )

vc_full_table
```

```{r}
vc_full_wide <- vc_full_table %>%
  select(Metric, Type, grp, prop_pct) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = grp,
    values_from = prop_pct,
    names_prefix = "VarPct_"
  )

vc_full_wide
```

## Meta-analysis of HG vs LG effect size

```{r}
# Inspect effect sizes per lab
esdat  # lab, yi, vi

# Meta-analysis result summary table
meta_summary <- tibble(
  pooled_g = as.numeric(res$b[1]),
  ci_low   = as.numeric(res$ci.lb),
  ci_high  = as.numeric(res$ci.ub),
  tau2     = as.numeric(res$tau2),
  I2       = as.numeric(res$I2)
) %>%
  mutate(
    CI = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci_low, ci_high)
  )

meta_summary
```
